validation_details: Geometric validity: The setup is a circle of radius 5 centered at the origin with a vertical line x = 4 cutting the circle. This is consistent with the actual intersection coordinates P(4, 3) and Q(4, -3). All elements mentioned in the problem are present and consistent with the description. The coordinates implied by the setup (P(4,3) and Q(4,-3)) are consistent with the line x = 4 intersecting the circle x^2 + y^2 = 25. Overall status and consistency: The problem is mathematically sound, well-posed, and solvable with standard geometry methods.
